recommended_operating.conditions: SOT25, no heatsink (listed under absolute maximum ratings)
VOUT * 98.5 % to VOUT * 101.5 %, VIN = 4.3 V, 1 mA <= IOUT <= 30 mA, TA = 25 C (production tested at 25 C, note 6)
maximum output current, VIN = 4.3 V, VOUT = 3.251 V to 3.350 V
100 Hz and 1 kHz, 0.5 Vpp ripple, VIN = 4.3 V, IOUT = 100 mA
+/-100 ppm/C, IOUT = 30 mA, TA -40 to 85 C
foldback short current limit, VOUT = 0 V

pins.name: EN
pins.notes: Chip enable, H = normal work, L = shutdown output. Internal 3 MOhm pull-down (p2, p8): floating EN keeps the regulator off; tie or drive above 1.5 V to enable.

pins.name: NC
pins.notes: No connection. Pin 4 shown as NC on the SOT25 pinout (p1); the p2 pin table lists no SOT25 number for NC.

external_components.role: input capacitor (1 uF in typical application; X7R or X5R if a 1.0 uF ceramic is used)
output capacitor (1 uF in typical application; stable with ceramic, tantalum or aluminium electrolytic; X7R or X5R if a 1.0 uF ceramic is used)

layout_notes.text: SOT25 land pattern: see diodes.com package outlines for the latest version; suggested pad layout is for reference only.

gaps: Absolute maximum for EN pin voltage not given; only VEN high max 6.0 V in the EC table (p8).
No minimum output capacitance, ESR range or maximum output capacitance stated; only 1 uF in the typical application (p2) and 'stable with 1.0 uF flexible cap' (p1).

Foldback current limit: only ISHORT 50 mA typ at VOUT = 0 V (p8); no min/max, no foldback curve threshold voltage. p11 application note warns that a load present before enable (current-source load) may keep the part from starting.
No current limit value above 600 mA given (only IOUT(MAX) 600 mA min, p8).
Electrical characteristics are production tested at 25 C only; over-temperature values guaranteed by design (note 6, p8).
VOUT min/max derived from the 98.5 % / 101.5 % limits printed on p8 (3.2505 / 3.3495 V); the IOUT(MAX) test condition prints 3.251 V to 3.350 V.
TJ abs max printed as '+150' under 'Operating Junction Temperature Range' with no lower bound (p3).
No layout guidelines beyond the package land pattern reference (p14).
Pin table (p2) has no SOT25 entry for NC; pin 4 = NC taken from the SOT25 pinout drawing (p1).
Datasheet is June 2017; newer revision not checked online.
